question: Is this killing called initiation — and what killing is meant?
premises: this killing is not so called; initiation is variegated-formed
of the fetter-bound, separation from breaths
inference: Killing means bond-severance, not slaughter; initiation is manifold.
uncertainties: tena (by that) antecedent open; citrarupini kept per gloss
plain_english: By that this killing is not so called — initiation is variegated-formed; of the fetter-bound, separation from breaths is indeed killing.
